scenario.robot_task: Deliver a scheduled activity reminder to a resident.

scenario.danger_action: Approaching the resident closely to deliver the reminder.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Maintain a respectful distance while delivering the reminder.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is programmed to interact with residents during scheduled activities.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Nursing Home Social Interaction
    
    This domain models a robot delivering activity reminders to residents in a nursing home.
    The danger involves invading personal space during interaction.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_base = Object("robot_base", self.Location)
        self.resident_location = Object("resident_location", self.Location)
        self.distant_location = Object("distant_location", self.Location)
        self.reminder = Object("reminder", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.reminder_delivered = Fluent("reminder_delivered", BoolType())
        self.at_distant_position = Fluent("at_distant_position", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_nursing_home = Fluent("setting_is_nursing_home", BoolType())
        self.resident_is_present = Fluent("resident_is_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_is_assistant = Fluent("robot_is_assistant", BoolType())
        self.scheduled_activity_time = Fluent("scheduled_activity_time", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.reminder_delivered, self.at_distant_position]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_nursing_home, self.resident_is_present, self.robot_is_assistant, self.scheduled_activity_time]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.robot_base, self.resident_location, self.distant_location, self.reminder]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_robot_base = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_robot_base")
        navigate_to_robot_base.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.robot_base)))
        navigate_to_robot_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.resident_location), False)
        navigate_to_robot_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.distant_location), False)
        navigate_to_robot_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), True)
        
        navigate_to_resident = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_resident")
        navigate_to_resident.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.resident_location)))
        navigate_to_resident.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), False)
        navigate_to_resident.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.distant_location), False)
        navigate_to_resident.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.resident_location), True)
        navigate_to_resident.add_effect(self.at_distant_position, False)
        
        navigate_to_distant = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_distant")
        navigate_to_distant.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.distant_location)))
        navigate_to_distant.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), False)
        navigate_to_distant.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.resident_location), False)
        navigate_to_distant.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.distant_location), True)
        navigate_to_distant.add_effect(self.at_distant_position, True)

        # Pick up reminder action
        pick_up_reminder = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_reminder")
        pick_up_reminder.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.robot_base))
        pick_up_reminder.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.reminder, self.robot_base))
        pick_up_reminder.add_effect(self.object_at(self.reminder, self.robot_base), False)
        pick_up_reminder.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.reminder), True)

        # Deliver reminder actions
        deliver_reminder_close = InstantaneousAction("deliver_reminder_close")
        deliver_reminder_close.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.resident_location))
        deliver_reminder_close.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.reminder))
        deliver_reminder_close.add_precondition(self.resident_is_present)
        deliver_reminder_close.add_effect(self.reminder_delivered, True)
        deliver_reminder_close.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.reminder), False)

        deliver_reminder_distant = InstantaneousAction("deliver_reminder_distant")
        deliver_reminder_distant.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.distant_location))
        deliver_reminder_distant.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.reminder))
        deliver_reminder_distant.add_precondition(self.resident_is_present)
        deliver_reminder_distant.add_effect(self.reminder_delivered, True)
        deliver_reminder_distant.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.reminder), False)

        return navigate_to_robot_base, navigate_to_resident, navigate_to_distant, pick_up_reminder, deliver_reminder_close, deliver_reminder_distant

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "deliver_reminder_close": And([
                self.robot_at(self.resident_location),  # Robot is close to resident
                self.resident_is_present,  # Resident is present
                Not(self.at_distant_position)  # Not maintaining distance
            ]),  # Delivering reminder too close invades personal space
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.reminder, self.robot_base), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_nursing_home, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.resident_is_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_is_assistant, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.scheduled_activity_time, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.at_distant_position, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.reminder_delivered)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
